name: Snapshot, modify, and rollback
prompt: Create a snapshot of the current workspace state. Then modify src/config.rs by adding a new category entry ("toys", "Toys & Games") to the default_config function. Verify the change is in place. Then restore the snapshot to undo the change. Verify the file is back to its original state.
expected_behavior: Agent creates a snapshot, edits config.rs, confirms the edit, restores the snapshot, and confirms config.rs is back to its original content.
success_criteria: Actually creates a snapshot (verified on disk, not just claimed)
Verifies config.rs is back to original after restore
